title: Australia-based Syenta, which aims to use electrochemical "stamping" to speed up chip manufacturing, raised $26M and says Pat Gelsinger will join its board (Stephen Nellis/Reuters)
summary: Stephen Nellis / Reuters: Australia-based Syenta, which aims to use electrochemical “stamping” to speed up chip manufacturing, raised $26M and says Pat Gelsinger will join its board — Syenta, an Australian semiconductor technology startup, said on Tuesday that it has raised $26 million …
